rows.note: Use 唔知 as the all-purpose everyday choice when someone lacks information or is unaware of a fact.

example.english: I was unaware that he took today off.
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 zi1 keoi5 gam1 jat6 ceng2 zo2 gaa2

rows.note: Use this when someone fails to notice something because they were not paying attention.

example.english: I was unaware that the bus had already left.
example.traditional: 我頭先睇手機，冇留意巴士已經開走咗。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tau4 sin1 tai2 sau2 gei1 mou5 lau4 ji3 baa1 si2 ji5 ging1 hoi1 zau2 zo2

rows.note: Use this when someone does not realize or notice something, rather than simply lacking information.

example.english: I was unaware that I was speaking so loudly.
example.traditional: 我唔覺自己講嘢咁大聲。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 gok3 zi6 gei2 gong2 je5 gam3 daai6 seng1
